metadata_lines.text: **Target Projects.** We select the recent versions of three large-scale and well-maintained C/C++ open-source projects for scanning, including the Linux kernel (v6.9.6), OpenSSL (v3.4.0), and 761 Libav (v12.3) .
**Static Analyzers.** We use three state-of-the-art and widely-adopted 763 static analyzers: CodeQL, Infer, and CppCheck.
